text:
Maria K: Heads up — Acme renewal is scheduled for next Tuesday. Procurement is asking for a signed SOW + PO before they can cut the PO. Pricing has a 10% uplift from last year; term stays 12 months. Can Legal and Sales help unblock? cc @Sam @Patrick :eyes:
Sam Chung: Thanks. Quick clarifying Qs — is the uplift applied to hosted usage only or to Dedicated as well? Also, did Acme request any capacity increases?
Maria K: Uplift is across the board. They are increasing Dedicated commit from 2 GPUs to 3 GPUs for the term. Old ARR was $120,000; new ARR is $132,000.
Patrick Lee: Procurement emailed procurement@acme.com and wants the SOW + quote PDF. They'll only issue PO once SOW text is final. They also asked for net-45 payment terms and a PO number to be referenced on the invoice.
Maria K: Jules — can Legal fast-track a short addendum that covers the capacity bump and standard T&C changes? No new data residency asks from the customer, just SLA clarifications.
Jules Rivera: I can do a 1-page addendum. Need to confirm whether we include the Dedicated node warranty paragraph or keep it standard. Nothing risky in the redline, should be a quick review. If you drop the redline here I can sign off today. :thumbsup:
Maria K: Dropping the minimal redline snippet below for review:
```
- Term: 12 months, effective 2025-07-01
- Capacity: Dedicated commit increased to 3x A100-equivalent GPUs
- Pricing: $132,000 for the term, billed per invoice schedule below
- Payment terms: Net 45 (customer request)
```
Patrick Lee: Forwarding invoice schedule to procurement when we have the PDF. Billing contact for Acme: billing@acme.com, PO prefix ACME-2025. Also need the remit address on the quote.
Maria K: Billing block to include on quote/invoice:
```
Acme Corp
Attn: Accounts Payable
billing@acme.com
PO: ACME-2025-XXXX
Remit: Redwood Inference, 1200 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94102
```
Jules Rivera: Reviewed redline. Small edit to the warranty sentence, otherwise good. I'll attach the addendum to the contract and send to Contract Bot for DocuSign.
Contract Bot: DocuSign envelope created (env_0x9c7a). Sent to Acme signatories and our legal reps. Status: awaiting signatures.
Ops Support: Noted — disabling auto-renew toggle (per customer request) and flagging account for onboarding to ensure the extra GPU is provisioned on day 1 after signature.
Maria K: Thanks everyone. I'll share the quote PDF in this thread when it's ready and follow up with procurement. If signatures come through, Patrick can you confirm when PO is in? :pray:
Patrick Lee: Will confirm as soon as PO arrives. I have a follow-up with procurement Thurs 10am PT.
Maria K: Perfect — appreciate the quick turnaround team. :rocket:
